chunks: Muhammad b. Ali Majilawayh (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi al-Khattab narrated to us from Muhammad b. Sinan from Ammar b. Marwan from Samaa from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:

Surely, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, bestowed gifts upon a community, and they were not thankful, so it became a scourge for them; and He tried a community with afflictions, and they were patient, so it became a blessing for them.
ai.seo_question: What happens to those who are ungrateful for blessings versus those who are patient with afflictions according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) teaches about the contrasting fates of two communities: one that received divine gifts but was ungrateful, causing those gifts to become a burden; and another that was tested with afflictions but remained patient, transforming those trials into blessings. This hadith emphasizes gratitude (shukr) and patience (sabr) as the two essential responses to divine decree.
